## Summary

Describe the user-visible problem and the smallest change that solves it.

## Verification

- [ ] `python -m unittest discover -s tests -v`
- [ ] `ruff check .`
- [ ] Relevant CLI or GUI behavior was checked with synthetic data

## Safety and rights

- [ ] I have the right to contribute every changed file.
- [ ] No secret, personal history, private media, or model weights are included.
- [ ] Network, history, Skill-loading, or validation behavior is documented if changed.
- [ ] The change does not execute untrusted Skill code.
